correctness.rationale: The exponential-clock representation induces exactly the random-priority matching. Conditional unoccupied-pair reaction rates are X_i X_j/N; martingale quadratic variations are bounded by T/N and Gronwall proves a uniform fixed-time fluid limit. Differentiating the explicit product parametrization verifies the ODE. The scalar clock increases to the reciprocal maximal fraction and identifies the product terminal state, including tied maxima. Every post-T edge consumes an outside-largest-class vertex, bounding the total late depletion by twice its remaining population, whose limiting density tends to zero. This bridges finite T to actual absorption and proves the entire theorem; boundedness yields expectation convergence. The standalone program verifies 37 exact small-instance identities and finite-size diagnostics, with no claim of exhaustive infinite verification.

value.rationale: For random dimer deposition a positive macroscopic jammed vacancy density can coexist with a perfect matching, as K_{8m,7m,5m} shows: its exact irreversible vacancy density tends to 3/160 despite an explicit perfect matching. The general q-class product expression and sharp disappearance when the largest fractions tie classify a natural physical kinetic observable, and are not just a change of variables or an optimal-graph matching count. No assertion of a fluctuation theorem or a spatially universal exponent is needed for its value.
